purpose: Temporary CELL-001 topology assumption contract so downstream residency, pack, plane, cloud inventory, secrets, and sovereign spec/fixture lanes can proceed without claiming production readiness or unblocking runtime promotion/rebalancer work.

source_refs.summary: Local JSON cell-topology foundation: five contexts/cells, one cloud-iac service tenant fixture, local evidence refs, and explicit non-claims for runtime/provider/Kubernetes/OpenTofu/Argo integrations.
Cell lifecycle local foundation declares OpenBao as future reference only, no raw secret material, no provisioning/runtime/DR/audit-chain claims, and local cell-binding/residency invariants only.
Accepted ADR-0158 canonical disposition enum, sovereign tenant pin overlay, global control-plane routing shape, and pack default topology matrix.
Accepted ADR-0161 canonical StorageClass names, per-pack CSI matrix, topology-aware provisioning, encryption, and workload contract.
Proposed planning source for cell tiers, cell routing layers, per-cell HSM partition, quarterly isolation evidence, and open questions.
Proposed planning source for residency classes, strict KR behavior, cross-region transfer governance, and failover semantics.
Proposed planning source for local multi-node Talos pool topology, cell-boundary enforcement, and object-store substrate; not runtime evidence.

service_tenant_fixture_contract.quarterly_isolation_evidence_claim: reference-shape only; this snapshot does not assert that evidence payloads exist or passed a runtime audit

cell_identity_and_routing: Cells are the planning blast-radius primitive for tenant/data-plane work; current local foundation has one cell per listed context/region and one cloud-iac service tenant fixture.
Cross-cell traffic is denied by default in the foundation fixture and must be represented by explicit future cross-cell contracts before any runtime route is allowed.
Edge, mesh, store, and event routing remain assumptions from ADR-0009 until a runtime CELL-001 reconciliation proves live routing, policy, and store bindings.
residency_and_region: The service fixture is strict_kr and active_passive in kr-seoul-1; downstream residency/spec lanes may use it as a KR-pinned planning input.

Accepted multi-region disposition authority is specs/multi-region-disposition-canonical.json; proposed ADR-0049 residency details are planning context only unless elevated by a later card/root pointer.
storage: The fixture uses canonical storage_class oya-pg-hot from specs/csi-storage-class-canonical.json.
Topology-aware provisioning and per-pack CSI bindings are assumed contract inputs only; this snapshot does not claim PVs, StorageClasses, or drivers exist in a live cluster.
secrets_and_hsm: Each foundation cell includes kms and secrets-bootstrap module refs; this is sufficient for downstream secrets contract vocabulary.
OpenBao/HSM/KEK/DEK behavior remains contract/runbook-only for SECRETS-001; no raw secret material, kubeconfig, provider credential, or OpenBao runtime call is introduced or claimed here.
planes_and_cloud_inventory: Data-plane behavior should be treated as cell-local; control/analytics/global-control-plane behavior must remain explicitly labelled and cannot infer runtime separation from this snapshot alone.
Cloud/DCIM inventory lanes may cite the five-context/five-cell local foundation as inventory scope, but must not claim provider resources, capacity telemetry, PUE/WUE, SLO, or live DCIM integration.
sovereign_and_airgap: Sovereign/air-gap lanes may use the strict_kr active_passive fixture as a seed for pack overlays and no-external-egress reasoning.
Signed bundle, offline ownership, no-external-egress validation, and RTO/SLO evidence remain future artifacts; this snapshot only fixes the topology assumption.

non_claims: no production-readiness, hyperscaler-grade, runtime-ready, or deployable-cell claim
no autosharding, auto-rebalance, dynamic sharding, tenant migration, promotion, drain, or decommission executor
no Argo CD API, Kubernetes API, OpenTofu CLI, provider API, or live mesh enforcement integration
no live capacity telemetry, measured SLO/SLI, active-active DR, failover drill, or runtime audit-chain persistence
no raw secret material, kubeconfig, provider token, credential, or OpenBao runtime access
no generated JSON hand edits and no changes to protected CI/release/governance roots
reconciliation_points_after_runtime_cell: Reconcile proposed ADR-0009/ADR-0049 terminology with accepted specs before promoting any binding runtime gate; especially cell tier casing, residency class names, and cross-cell contract fields.
Prove whether foundation.json remains the source fixture or is replaced by a runtime-discovered topology source once CELL-001 lands.
Replace evidence:// quarterly isolation reference shapes with actual evidence records or explicit blocked placeholders per network/storage/crypto/compute/audit category.
Verify live route-table/API-gateway behavior for sovereign pins and 421 redirects before downstream residency/sovereign lanes claim enforcement.
Verify KMS/HSM/OpenBao partition binding with synthetic non-prod rotation evidence before SECRETS-001 claims rotation readiness.
Verify topology-aware storage provisioning and per-pack CSI binding in a non-prod cluster before storage_class assumptions become runtime claims.
Use cloud-ci/Rust gate packets for future enforcement; do not extend retired local oya CLI merge authority.
